meta.recomputation_note: Entries marked coordinator_recomputation are exact recomputations from committed run records performed by this composition under maximum_runs: 0. They add to, and never replace, a reviewer's finding.
meta.ordering_rule: Refutations are listed first, and P-6 leads because it fell. The plan names P-6 as the prediction the Coordinator most expected to lose; a scoring that buried it under five confirmations would misreport the round.
meta.plan_count_discrepancy: review_plan.coordinator_prior's surrounding prose says 'Six predictions'; the list contains SEVEN (P-1..P-7). All seven are scored here. The prose miscount is recorded as a defect found and not fixed (the plan is immutable), not repaired.

headline.the_two_that_fell_are_the_two_that_decid: P-6 and P-7 are the only priors that bear on the transition and on completion criterion 1. Both fell. The five confirmations are all about DEFECTS the Coordinator already expected to find, so they moved nothing: confirming that you were right about what is broken is not the same as learning what the run established.
headline.what_this_means_for_reading_the_composit: This round is NOT 'three reviewers concurred with the Coordinator'. On the two load-bearing priors the review overturned the Coordinator. That is the outcome the plan said would be most valuable, and it is the reason the decision is inconclusive rather than the refine that was predicted.

refuted.why_first: The plan flags this prior with THIS_IS_THE_PREDICTION_I_MOST_EXPECT_TO_LOSE. It lost. Everything downstream — the transition, the hypothesis status, completion criterion 1 — turns on it.
refuted.prediction_as_written: Despite P-3 through P-5, the experiment's OBJECTIVE is answered, and answered in the negative direction: GOAL-DREG-001's Macaulay-rank statistic is not commensurable with d_F4, because its degree is an input to a fixed-degree rank computation while d_F4 is an output of a terminating algorithm, so that campaign's degree-5 and degree-6 measurements do NOT bear on Assumption 1. Completion criterion 1 is satisfiable on the 'explicitly as not bearing on it' branch it names.
refuted.the_escape_clause_the_plan_wrote_for_its: If a reviewer shows that the input-versus-output distinction is argued and not measured, then the run did not settle the map -- it stated it -- the honest decision is `inconclusive` rather than `refine`, the finding is a technique note rather than evidence, and completion criterion 1 stays open.
refuted.corroborating_reviewer: J-1 (TASK-20260921-f2d82f) independently, on its own joint, found nothing in the run that measured the DREG statistic as an output; it had no occasion to rule on the map.

evidence_that_settled_it.finding: The input-versus-output distinction is ARGUED IN PROSE in task-report.md, not measured. No instrument in the run varies the DREG statistic's degree as an output. The distinction is a reading of two definitions, which is a correct reading and still not a measurement.

The same distinction was ALREADY STATED in EV-DREG-008's own boundaries block ('Structural deficit_genuine is not theoretical d_reg'). The run therefore restated a distinction the target campaign had already recorded, rather than establishing a new one.

NO SHARED CELL with the target campaign. EV-DREG-008's cell is n=12, t=3, ti=0, seed=2026, D=6. No instance in RUN-SEMBIN-b6eb9f matches it. Completion criterion 1 requires the map 'instrumented on identical instances'; the intersection is empty.

31 instances carry a completed macaulay_single_level at BOTH D=3 and D=4 alongside a d_F4_semaev value. So the DREG-side instrument RAN, widely — and its output is a rank at an input degree, never a degree. The material for a real map exists in the package and was not used to build one.

refuted.what_i_now_hold: The run STATED the map; it did not instrument it. A definitional observation in a task report is not an instrumented map on identical instances, and the criterion's own last clause — 'an unstated map does not' — is a bar on unstated maps, not a licence for asserted ones.
refuted.consequence: Completion criterion 1 is NOT met, on neither branch. The 'explicitly as not bearing on it' branch is the plausible one and it is still open: reaching it needs the DREG statistic instrumented as an output on cells shared with GOAL-DREG-001, which this run did not do.
refuted.adversarial_note_against_myself: The tempting move here is to say the distinction is definitionally obvious, therefore stating it suffices, therefore the criterion is discharged. I reject that. If a prose distinction discharged the criterion it was discharged before this batch opened, by EV-DREG-008's boundaries block, and this experiment had nothing to add. The criterion asks for instrumentation because instrumentation is what nobody had.

refuted.prediction_as_written: The correct decision is `refine`: not `support` (the hypothesis predicted d_F4 <= D with STRICTNESS on some instance, and strictness was not observed), not `weaken` or `reject_scoped` (the quantity the hypothesis named was never measured, so there is nothing about it to reject), and not `replicate` as a first move (re-running the same instrument pair would reproduce the same definitional gap).
refuted.what_survived_of_it: The three EXCLUSIONS all hold and are adopted in DEC-20260921-2c62d7: not support (strictness was not observed — separation is 0 on all 11 rows where both instruments returned), not weaken or reject_scoped (the hypothesis's named quantity was never measured as an output, and one unreplicated empirical-only run cannot carry reject_scoped), not replicate as a first move (the same instrument pair reproduces the same gap).
refuted.what_fell: The positive half. `refine` was wrong; the transition is `inconclusive`.
refuted.settled_by: The plan itself, conditionally, plus J-2 on the merits.

evidence_that_settled_it.finding: '`inconclusive` is a legitimate alternative and follows immediately if P-6 falls. I am recording `refine` as my prior so that an `inconclusive` outcome reads as the review overturning me rather than as my own conclusion.' P-6 fell, so the plan's own pre-committed consequent fires.

evidence_that_settled_it.source: J-2 objections.json OBJ-1 with coordinator composition
evidence_that_settled_it.finding: Independently of the plan's conditional, `refine` is wrong on the merits. `refine` presupposes a comparison that ran and needs sharpening. Here the declared primary metric was never computed as an output at all, so there is no measured comparison to refine — the next move is to BUILD the instrument, which is what inconclusive-plus-a-named-next-action records.

refuted.what_i_now_hold: `inconclusive`. Stated plainly: this run settled less than the campaign hoped. It did not establish the map, and it did not fail to establish it for an interesting mathematical reason — it measured a different pair of quantities than the contract declared.
refuted.adversarial_note_against_myself: `refine` was available and would have read as progress, kept the hypothesis moving, and left criterion 1 'nearly discharged'. That is exactly the failure mode this round was set up to catch, and my own prior was the thing most likely to cause it. I am recording that the plan's conditional is what protected the decision, not my judgement in the moment.

confirmed.prediction_as_written: The byte-identity control is NOT satisfied as the contract specifies it. The contract requires that 'both instruments' recorded input hashes' be COMPARED; manifest.yaml instead records 'system_sha256 and input_sha256 recorded per record and EQUAL BY CONSTRUCTION'. An assertion that they must be equal is not the comparison the control asks for, and 'by construction' is precisely the claim a byte-identity control exists to test.

evidence_that_settled_it.finding: Confirmed as predicted: the control was REFRAMED from a comparison into an assertion. J-1's words: "validity.reason asserts 'byte identity holds on every instance'. Nothing in the run checked that; the assertion is true only because this validation checked it."

J-1 then PERFORMED the missing per-record comparison and it PASSED. So the control's conclusion is true; only the run's warrant for it was absent. This is the least damaging way P-1 could be confirmed and it is recorded as such.

STRONGER THAN THE PRIOR CLAIMED, and this is a defect of the RUN. run_cells.py assigns input_sha256 and system_sha256 from the SAME variable. The equality is therefore not merely asserted-rather-than-compared; within a single record it is VACUOUS — a comparison of a value against itself cannot fail. J-1's independent cross-record comparison is what gives the control any force at all.

confirmed.what_i_now_hold: The control's stated outcome is true on J-1's evidence, not on the run's. The run's own implementation of it could not have detected a violation.

confirmed.prediction_as_written: The headline closure_D - d_F4 = 0 on 9 of 9 instances REPRODUCES from the raw per-instance records, independently of summarize.py.

with_both = 11, not 9. The prior's instance count was low. The trigger clause of P-2's what_would_change_my_mind ('a different instance count') fired on the count while the separation value held on every row.

confirmed.what_i_now_hold: Reproduction is the strongest thing this run earned, and it is genuine: J-3 rebuilt it convention-independently and it could have failed. What it reproduces is still an agreement between two F4-side quantities (see P-3), so a clean reproduction does not rescue the map.

confirmed.prediction_as_written: The contract's declared primary metric `D_macaulay_rank_statistic` was NEVER MEASURED AS AN OUTPUT, and the run substituted a new output quantity, `closure_D`, that the contract does not name. The separation the contract declared, `separation_D_minus_d_F4`, is therefore not the separation reported. This is a deviation of CONTENT, contradicting the run's own statement that its seven deviations are 'all for cost, none for content' -- and it is not among those seven.

evidence_that_settled_it.finding: Confirmed in full. The contract's primary metric was never computed. closure_D was substituted, and the substitution was UNDECLARED.

The binding is literal: D_macaulay_rank_statistic=closure_D. The contract's metric NAME is bound to closure_D's VALUE, so raw records carry both side by side and a reader of summary.json alone cannot see the substitution.

closure_D is F4-side BY ITS OWN DEFINITION: 'G_D is a Groebner basis <=> F4 completes with step degree <= D'. So closure_D - d_F4 = 0 compares two F4-side quantities. This is the single finding that most constrains the composition.
protocol_deviations: [] and unexpected_observations: []. A content substitution of the primary metric is recorded nowhere in the manifest.

the_plans_least_hostile_reading_and_whet.plan_expected: the substitution to be CORRECT science and a defect in the CONTRACT rather than in the run: the contract presumed a 'D' comparable to d_F4, and the DREG statistic is not one, because its degree is an input. The run appears to have discovered that and responded by constructing the output quantity the comparison actually needs.
the_plans_least_hostile_reading_and_whet.verdict: partly survived, and this is where the honest reading is split
the_plans_least_hostile_reading_and_whet.detail: The CONTRACT is genuinely defective — it declared a primary metric that is not a degree and cannot be differenced against d_F4, and the remedy is a new contract, not a re-run. The run's constructed replacement, closure_D, is a well-defined and useful quantity. But the plan's hoped-for conclusion does not follow: closure_D is not 'the output quantity the comparison actually needs', because it is F4-side, so it cannot stand on the DREG side of a d_F4-to-DREG map. The run built a real instrument for a different comparison than the one the goal needs.
the_plans_least_hostile_reading_and_whet.consequence: The defect is split: CONTRACT (declared an unusable metric) and RUN (substituted silently, and substituted something that does not bridge the two sides). Both remedies are named in DEC-20260921-2c62d7's next_actions.

confirmed.defect_class: both — contract for declaring it, run for substituting undeclared

confirmed.prediction_as_written: The contract's falsification criterion is INTERNALLY DEFECTIVE. It says 'D - d_F4 = 0 on every measured instance including the off-diagonal cells refutes the hypothesis in the direction that matters most: the two statistics would then be the same quantity here, and GOAL-DREG-001's degree-5/6 measurements WOULD be in tension with Assumption 1.' Under the only D measured as an output (closure_D) the antecedent HOLDS, and the consequent does NOT follow, because closure_D is not the DREG statistic. The criterion conflates two different D's.

evidence_that_settled_it.finding: Confirmed: the falsification criterion is UNSOUND AS WRITTEN. It conflates the degree at which a Macaulay matrix is BUILT with the degree a system ATTAINS. Those are different quantities and the criterion's consequent needs the second while its antecedent is satisfied by the first.

evidence_that_settled_it.source: coordinator composition over J-2 and J-3
evidence_that_settled_it.finding: The antecedent is factually satisfied: separation is 0 on all 11 rows where both instruments returned (J-3). So a Coordinator applying the contract MECHANICALLY would now record that GOAL-DREG-001's degree-5/6 measurements are in tension with Assumption 1 — which is false, and is the opposite of what the evidence supports.

confirmed.what_i_now_hold: The criterion fired and its attached conclusion is refused. This is recorded explicitly in DEC-20260921-2c62d7 and in analysis.md section 3, because a later reader who finds 'falsification criterion satisfied' in the contract and stops there will draw exactly the wrong conclusion. Refusing a triggered criterion is a protocol defect finding, NOT a post-hoc change of success criteria: the criterion is not being rewritten, it is being recorded as unsound with its antecedent's factual status stated.
confirmed.why_this_is_not_moving_the_goalposts: No amendment is being made to the contract and no success criterion is being restated. EXP-SEMBIN-c2c312's falsification_criterion stands in the record exactly as written. What this composition adds is a finding ABOUT it, which is what a review round is for. A superseding contract, if written, carries a protocol_amendment.

confirmed.prediction_as_written: The success criterion is NOT fully met, because one of its four conjuncts -- 'the matched-null separation differs from the structured separation' -- is UNEVALUABLE: the null's F4 hit the wall cap and its closure returned undetermined, so the null has no separation at all (manifest records null_f4_d_F4 null and null_closure_D null). The contract's third invalidation rule, which voids the run if the null separation EQUALS the structured one, is likewise unevaluable rather than passed.

evidence_that_settled_it.finding: Confirmed on both halves, in J-1's words: "The null's F4 hit the 3600 s wall cap (workerA:28, 3600.2 s) and its closure returned undetermined at D = 3 and 4 with D = 5 above the column cap, so no null separation exists and contract invalidation rule 3 cannot be evaluated from the records. evidence_that_settled_it.finding: The null's wall-cap stop is an INFRASTRUCTURE OUTCOME. It is not negative evidence about the null and not a passed control. Unevaluable is the correct and only reading.

confirmed.what_i_now_hold: The success criterion is not fully met — one conjunct is unevaluable. Invalidation rule 3 is unevaluable, which is NOT the same as passed; the run is not voided by it, and it is not supported by it either. The plan's observation about the producer's substitute claim also holds: the report's weaker claim (the degree-4 SUFFICIENT verdict is not a Macaulay-shape artifact, the null reaching rank 11186 of 59536 where the structured system reaches 59530) looks true and useful, and is simply not the control the contract declared. It is recorded as a substitution rather than absorbed.
confirmed.controls_before_belief_note: Under the inventor protocol the declared null control did not run to a comparable result. The structured separation therefore has no matched null behind it, and that is a stated limitation of EV-SEMBIN-c6e9ad rather than something the substitute claim repairs.
confirmed.defect_class: run (the null was launched under caps that could not reach a result), with no contract defect — the contract's control was well specified

cross_cutting.what_the_scoring_pattern_shows: Every prior about a DEFECT was confirmed; every prior about what the run ESTABLISHED was refuted. The Coordinator read the package's weaknesses accurately in advance and overestimated what survived them. That asymmetry is the finding of this scoring exercise and it is the reason the decision is inconclusive.
cross_cutting.why_not: On the two priors that decided anything, the review overturned the Coordinator. P-6's own escape clause was written in advance and fired exactly as written, which is the mechanism working rather than luck.
cross_cutting.what_a_reviewer_could_not_have_told_me: No single reviewer's verdict is a verdict on the run. J-1 ruled breaks on validity and controls, J-2 breaks on the metric and the map, J-3 holds on re-derivation. The composition — that the run reproduces exactly a comparison the goal did not need — is mine and belongs to no reviewer.
